title: Sandboxes
description: Every Reliant-hosted sandbox: the workspace pods in ws-* namespaces, from their kubelet series and their daemon's `machine health` / `machine volume` / `exec finished` lines. A sandbox appears only while it is awake: a suspended one has no pod and writes nothing, so every panel is empty when all are asleep or none exist. The platform's own self-hosted machines (the pipeline boxes) are not sandboxes: they are on the Platform machines dashboard. Replaces Dev boxes and Machine health.

panels.title: Sandboxes now
panels.description: Sandboxes running at the range end: awake pods in ws-* with a kubelet sample in the 5 minutes before it, their owners, and the CPU and memory they use then. A suspended sandbox has no pod and is not counted, so 0 means none is awake, not that the data is missing.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExact(pod) AS sandboxes, uniqExact(ns) AS users_with_a_sandbox, round(sum(cpu), 2) AS cpu_cores_in_use, round(sum(mem) / 1073741824, 1) AS memory_gib_in_use
FROM (
  SELECT pod, ns, sum(cpu) AS cpu, sum(mem) AS mem FROM (
    SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS ns, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container,
           argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage') AS cpu,
           argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set') AS mem
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName IN ('container.cpu.usage', 'container.memory.working_set') AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
    GROUP BY pod, ns, container)
  GROUP BY pod, ns)

panels.title: Sandboxes now · in-guest health
panels.description: Sandboxes whose daemon logged a health sample in the 5 minutes before the range end, how many run above 1.5 load per CPU, the worst load per CPU, the lowest free disk share, heavy commands waiting for a slot, and `go install .../forge@` builds running, summed over sandboxes. An awake sandbox whose daemon predates the sample is counted in Sandboxes now but not here.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExact(machine) AS sandboxes_sampled, countIf(load > 1.5) AS over_1_5_load_per_cpu, round(max(load), 2) AS worst_load_per_cpu, round(min(free), 3) AS min_disk_free, sum(waiting) AS heavy_waiting, sum(forge) AS forge_installs FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName AS machine, argMax(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['load1_per_cpu']), Timestamp) AS load, argMax(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['disk_min_free_ratio']), Timestamp) AS free, argMax(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_waiting']), Timestamp) AS waiting, argMax(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['forge_installs']), Timestamp) AS forge
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health'
  GROUP BY machine)

panels.title: Awake sandboxes
panels.description: Distinct sandboxes (pods) with a kubelet sample in each bucket. A suspended sandbox has no pod and drops out; a resume brings it back under a new pod uid. The steady level is the fleet the daemon cluster is carrying.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS awake_sandboxes
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Fleet CPU and memory in use
panels.description: Total CPU cores and memory working set in GiB summed over every awake sandbox, per bucket (mean per sandbox, then summed).
panels.sql:
SELECT t, round(sum(cpu), 2) AS cpu_cores, round(sum(mem) / 1073741824, 1) AS memory_gib
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container,
         ifNotFinite(avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage'), 0) AS cpu, ifNotFinite(avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set'), 0) AS mem
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName IN ('container.cpu.usage', 'container.memory.working_set') AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
  GROUP BY t, pod, container)
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Fleet utilization · CPU per sandbox
panels.description: How many sandboxes sit in each band of CPU cores. Each sandbox's value is the mean of its containers' CPU over the range; a sandbox counts once however long it was awake. Bands are absolute cores, not a share of the sandbox's size.
panels.sql:
SELECT multiIf(cpu < 0.5, '1 · under 0.5', cpu < 1, '2 · 0.5 to 1', cpu < 2, '3 · 1 to 2', cpu < 4, '4 · 2 to 4', cpu < 8, '5 · 4 to 8', cpu < 16, '6 · 8 to 16', '7 · 16 and over') AS cpu_cores_band, count() AS sandboxes
FROM (SELECT pod, sum(c) AS cpu FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, avg(Value) AS c
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) GROUP BY pod, container) GROUP BY pod)
GROUP BY cpu_cores_band ORDER BY cpu_cores_band

panels.title: Fleet utilization · memory per sandbox
panels.description: How many sandboxes sit in each band of memory working set. Each sandbox's value is its PEAK over the range: the highest total of its containers at one moment (60s), the figure an OOM kill is decided on.
panels.sql:
SELECT multiIf(mem_gib < 1, '1 · under 1 GiB', mem_gib < 2, '2 · 1 to 2', mem_gib < 4, '3 · 2 to 4', mem_gib < 8, '4 · 4 to 8', mem_gib < 16, '5 · 8 to 16', mem_gib < 32, '6 · 16 to 32', '7 · 32 GiB and over') AS memory_gib_band, count() AS sandboxes
FROM (
  SELECT pod, max(total) / 1073741824 AS mem_gib FROM (
    SELECT pod, b, sum(m) AS total FROM (
      SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond(60)) AS b, max(Value) AS m
      FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
      GROUP BY pod, container, b)
    GROUP BY pod, b)
  GROUP BY pod)
GROUP BY memory_gib_band ORDER BY memory_gib_band

panels.title: CPU per sandbox (top 10)
panels.description: CPU cores used by each of the ten busiest sandboxes, mean per bucket, summed over a sandbox's containers. Sandboxes are ranked by their peak TOTAL over the range. Group names are the pod, which is ws-<workspace id>.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, pod, round(sum(c), 3) AS cpu_cores FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, avg(Value) AS c
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (
    SELECT pod FROM (
      SELECT pod, b, sum(v) AS total FROM (
        SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond(60)) AS b, avg(Value) AS v
        FROM otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
        GROUP BY pod, container, b)
      GROUP BY pod, b)
    GROUP BY pod ORDER BY max(total) DESC LIMIT 10)
  GROUP BY t, pod, container)
GROUP BY t, pod ORDER BY t

panels.title: Memory per sandbox (top 10)
panels.description: Memory working set of the ten largest sandboxes, ranked by their peak TOTAL over the range. Each point is the highest total of a sandbox's containers at one moment (60s) inside the bucket.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, pod, max(total) AS memory FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(b, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, pod, b, sum(m) AS total FROM (
    SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond(60)) AS b, max(Value) AS m
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (
    SELECT pod FROM (
      SELECT pod, b, sum(v) AS total FROM (
        SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond(60)) AS b, max(Value) AS v
        FROM otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
        GROUP BY pod, container, b)
      GROUP BY pod, b)
    GROUP BY pod ORDER BY max(total) DESC LIMIT 10)
    GROUP BY pod, container, b)
  GROUP BY t, pod, b)
GROUP BY t, pod ORDER BY t

panels.title: CPU against request
panels.description: CPU used as a fraction of the sandbox's CPU request (1 = using exactly what it is guaranteed; above 1 it is bursting into spare node capacity). Each point is divided by the request in force AT THAT TIME for the same pod uid, so a resumed or resized sandbox keeps its own history. Needs k8s.container.cpu_request.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, pod, round(max(ratio), 3) AS of_request FROM (
  SELECT u.t AS t, u.pod AS pod, u.v / d.v AS ratio FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, max(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, avg(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) GROUP BY t, pod, uid, container) AS u
  ASOF INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TimeUnix AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, Value AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.cpu_request' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) AND Value > 0) AS d
  ON u.uid = d.uid AND u.container = d.container AND u.ts >= d.ts)
GROUP BY t, pod ORDER BY t

panels.title: CPU against limit
panels.description: CPU used as a fraction of the sandbox's CPU limit. Near 1 the sandbox is being throttled. Divided by the limit in force at that time for the same pod uid (a resume or resize keeps its own history). Needs k8s.container.cpu_limit.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, pod, round(max(ratio), 3) AS of_limit FROM (
  SELECT u.t AS t, u.pod AS pod, u.v / d.v AS ratio FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, max(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, avg(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) GROUP BY t, pod, uid, container) AS u
  ASOF INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TimeUnix AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, Value AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.cpu_limit' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) AND Value > 0) AS d
  ON u.uid = d.uid AND u.container = d.container AND u.ts >= d.ts)
GROUP BY t, pod ORDER BY t

panels.title: Memory against limit
panels.description: Peak memory working set as a fraction of the sandbox's memory limit. Near 1 the next allocation is an OOM kill. Divided by the limit in force at that time for the same pod uid (a resume or resize keeps its own history). Needs k8s.container.memory_limit.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, pod, round(max(ratio), 3) AS of_limit FROM (
  SELECT u.t AS t, u.pod AS pod, u.v / d.v AS ratio FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, max(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) GROUP BY t, pod, uid, container) AS u
  ASOF INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TimeUnix AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, Value AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.memory_limit' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) AND Value > 0) AS d
  ON u.uid = d.uid AND u.container = d.container AND u.ts >= d.ts)
GROUP BY t, pod ORDER BY t

panels.title: Daily · load per CPU
panels.description: Per UTC day across every sampled sandbox: the median and p95 of the 1-minute load divided by the sandbox's CPUs, and the share of samples above 1.5 (the MachineLoadHigh line). The needle to move: these fall when a fix works.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, round(quantile(0.5)(l), 2) AS p50_load_per_cpu, round(quantile(0.95)(l), 2) AS p95_load_per_cpu, round(countIf(l > 1.5) / count(), 3) AS share_over_1_5
FROM (SELECT Timestamp, toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['load1_per_cpu']) AS l FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' AND isNotNull(l))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Daily · pressure and heavy-slot wait
panels.description: Per UTC day: mean CPU, memory and IO pressure (PSI some, avg60, percent of time stalled), and the mean and p95 of the oldest heavy-slot waiter's wait in seconds.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, round(avg(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_cpu_some_avg60'])), 1) AS cpu_psi, round(avg(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_memory_some_avg60'])), 1) AS memory_psi, round(avg(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_io_some_avg60'])), 1) AS io_psi, round(avg(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_oldest_wait_s'])), 0) AS mean_slot_wait_s, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_oldest_wait_s'])), 0) AS p95_slot_wait_s
FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Daily · timeouts, forge builds, disk
panels.description: Per UTC day: commands that hit their timeout (`exec finished`, outcome_class=timeout), the most concurrent `go install .../forge@` builds seen on one sandbox, and the lowest free share of any volume.
panels.sql:
SELECT day, sum(timeouts) AS tool_timeouts, max(forge) AS peak_forge_installs, round(min(free), 3) AS min_disk_free FROM (
  SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, countIf(endsWith(Body, 'exec finished') AND LogAttributes['outcome_class'] = 'timeout') AS timeouts,
         maxIf(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['forge_installs']), Body = 'machine health') AS forge, minIf(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['disk_min_free_ratio']), Body = 'machine health') AS free
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND (endsWith(Body, 'exec finished') OR Body = 'machine health')
  GROUP BY day)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Load per CPU (top 10)
panels.description: The 1-minute load divided by the sandbox's CPUs (the cgroup quota, else nproc), mean per bucket, for the ten sandboxes with the highest peak. Above 1 work queues for a CPU; MachineLoadHigh fires past 1.5 for 15 minutes.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, machine, round(avg(l), 2) AS load_per_cpu FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, ServiceName AS machine, toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['load1_per_cpu']) AS l FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' AND isNotNull(l))
WHERE machine IN (SELECT ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['load1_per_cpu'])) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY t, machine ORDER BY t

panels.title: Pressure stall (PSI, worst sandbox)
panels.description: Percent of the last 60s that some task stalled on CPU, memory or IO (and, for memory and IO, that all did: full), the worst sandbox per bucket. Memory full is reclaim thrashing; IO full is a saturated disk. Filter to one sandbox to read it alone.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, round(max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_cpu_some_avg60'])), 1) AS cpu_some, round(max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_memory_some_avg60'])), 1) AS memory_some, round(max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_memory_full_avg60'])), 1) AS memory_full, round(max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_io_some_avg60'])), 1) AS io_some, round(max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['psi_io_full_avg60'])), 1) AS io_full
FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health'
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Heavy slots: held and waiting
panels.description: Heavy commands (builds, test lanes, codegen) holding a slot and waiting for one, summed over sandboxes, with the slots there are. Waiters that grow while held stays at capacity is a sandbox taking more heavy work than it can run.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, sum(held) AS held, sum(waiting) AS waiting, sum(slots) AS slots FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, ServiceName AS machine, max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_held'])) AS held, max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_waiting'])) AS waiting, max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_slots'])) AS slots FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' GROUP BY t, machine)
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Oldest heavy-slot wait (top 10)
panels.description: How long the longest waiter has waited for a heavy slot, per sandbox, worst per bucket. A command's wait counts against its timeout.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, machine, max(w) AS oldest_wait FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, ServiceName AS machine, toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_oldest_wait_s']) AS w FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' AND isNotNull(w))
WHERE machine IN (SELECT ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['heavy_oldest_wait_s'])) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY t, machine ORDER BY t

panels.title: Concurrent forge builds
panels.description: `go install github.com/reliant-labs/forge/...@<version>` processes running, per sandbox (the most in each bucket). More than one on a sandbox is agents compiling the same pin at once.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, ServiceName AS machine, max(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['forge_installs'])) AS forge_installs FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine health' AND toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['forge_installs']) > 0
GROUP BY t, machine ORDER BY t

panels.title: Commands that hit their timeout, per hour
panels.description: Shell and tool commands whose timeout fired (`exec finished` with outcome_class=timeout in the daemon log), per sandbox per hour. MachineToolTimeouts fires at 20 in an hour on one sandbox.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS t, ServiceName AS machine, count() AS timeouts FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND endsWith(Body, 'exec finished') AND LogAttributes['outcome_class'] = 'timeout'
GROUP BY t, machine ORDER BY t

panels.title: Free disk per volume
panels.description: Free share of each volume a sandbox's builds and tools write to (diskwatch: home, build caches & docker, temp, system), the lowest per bucket. MachineDiskLow fires under 10%; the disk guard refuses heavy commands past 95% used.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', LogAttributes['volume']) AS volume, round(min(toFloat64OrNull(LogAttributes['free_ratio'])), 3) AS free FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName)) AND Body = 'machine volume'
GROUP BY t, volume ORDER BY t

panels.title: Restarts in the range
panels.description: In-place container restarts over the range (a restart that keeps the pod uid and raises restartCount; growth is read from an hour before the range starts, so none at its start is missed), the OOM kills among them, and how many sandboxes were hit. A planned suspend/resume is NOT here: it recreates the pod, whose counter starts again at 0.
panels.sql:
SELECT sum(grew) AS restarts, sumIf(grew, reason = 'OOMKilled') AS oom_kills, uniqExactIf(pod, grew > 0) AS sandboxes_restarted
FROM (
SELECT t, pod, container, uid, sum(g) AS grew, argMaxIf(reason, TimeUnix, reason != '') AS reason FROM (
  SELECT TimeUnix, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, pod, container, uid, reason,
         greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY uid, container ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS g
  FROM (
    SELECT TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, Value AS v, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.last_terminated_reason'] AS reason
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))))
WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY t, pod, container, uid)

panels.title: In-place restarts by last exit reason
panels.description: Container restarts per bucket, split by why the container last died as the kubelet reports it (OOMKilled, Error, Completed ...). 'unknown' is a restart whose reason had not been recorded yet. Raises on the same counter as the WorkspaceContainerRestarted alert.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, if(reason = '', 'unknown', reason) AS exit_reason, sum(grew) AS restarts
FROM (
SELECT t, pod, container, uid, sum(g) AS grew, argMaxIf(reason, TimeUnix, reason != '') AS reason FROM (
  SELECT TimeUnix, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, pod, container, uid, reason,
         greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY uid, container ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS g
  FROM (
    SELECT TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, Value AS v, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.last_terminated_reason'] AS reason
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))))
WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY t, pod, container, uid) WHERE grew > 0 GROUP BY t, exit_reason ORDER BY t

panels.title: OOM kills by sandbox
panels.description: Restarts whose last terminated reason is OOMKilled, per sandbox. A sandbox killed by its own workload is the user's; many sandboxes at once on one node is the platform's (see Sandboxes by node).
panels.sql:
SELECT t, pod, sum(grew) AS oom_kills
FROM (
SELECT t, pod, container, uid, sum(g) AS grew, argMaxIf(reason, TimeUnix, reason != '') AS reason FROM (
  SELECT TimeUnix, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, pod, container, uid, reason,
         greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY uid, container ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS g
  FROM (
    SELECT TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, Value AS v, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.last_terminated_reason'] AS reason
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))))
WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY t, pod, container, uid) WHERE grew > 0 AND reason = 'OOMKilled' GROUP BY t, pod ORDER BY t

panels.title: Pods recreated (resumes and node moves)
panels.description: New pod uids first seen in each bucket. A suspend/resume, a node move or a VM re-create gives the sandbox a fresh pod and resets its restart count, so these are NOT in-place restarts. Pods already running when the range starts are not counted.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(first_seen, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, count() AS recreated_pods
FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS uid, min(TimeUnix) AS first_seen FROM otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) GROUP BY uid)
WHERE first_seen >= {from:DateTime64(9)} + INTERVAL 2 MINUTE
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Pending, failed or unknown pods
panels.description: Sandbox pods whose phase is not Running or Succeeded, counted per bucket by phase (Pending = capacity or scheduling; Failed; Unknown = the node lost it). Phase is the cluster collector's k8s.pod.phase.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t,
       multiIf(ph = 1, 'Pending', ph = 4, 'Failed', 'Unknown') AS phase, uniqExact(pod) AS pods
FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, Value AS ph FROM otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.phase' AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])))
WHERE ph IN (1, 4, 5) GROUP BY t, phase ORDER BY t

panels.title: Sandboxes by node
panels.description: Awake sandboxes on each node at the range end, with what they use. One node holding most of the OOM kills or the CPU is a node problem, not a user's. The node is stamped on the sandbox's samples by the node agent (k8s.node.name).
panels.sql:
SELECT node, count() AS sandboxes, round(sum(cpu), 2) AS cpu_cores, round(sum(mem) / 1073741824, 1) AS memory_gib FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS node, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage') AS cpu, argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set') AS mem
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName IN ('container.cpu.usage', 'container.memory.working_set') AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'])) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] != ''
  GROUP BY node, pod)
GROUP BY node ORDER BY sandboxes DESC

panels.title: Noisiest sandboxes
panels.description: The busiest sandboxes of the range by peak CPU, measured as the sandbox total (its containers summed at one moment): workspace id, owning user id and owning org id (never an email; personal = no organization owns it), node, CPU and memory, and the highest restart count seen. Ids are the operator's labels; samples from before they were stamped fall back to the pod and namespace names.
panels.sql:
SELECT workspace_id, user_id, if(org_id = '', 'personal', org_id) AS owner_org_id, argMaxIf(node, last_seen, node != '') AS node,
       round(avg(cpu), 2) AS cpu_avg_cores, round(max(cpu), 2) AS cpu_peak_cores, round(max(mem) / 1073741824, 1) AS memory_peak_gib,
       max(restarts) AS restarts_total
FROM (
  SELECT workspace_id, user_id, org_id, b, sum(cpu) AS cpu, sum(mem) AS mem, max(restarts) AS restarts,
         argMaxIf(node, seen, node != '') AS node, max(seen) AS last_seen
  FROM (
    SELECT if(ResourceAttributes['reliant.workspace.id'] != '', ResourceAttributes['reliant.workspace.id'], replaceRegexpOne(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], '^ws-', '')) AS workspace_id, if(ResourceAttributes['reliant.user.id'] != '', ResourceAttributes['reliant.user.id'], replaceRegexpOne(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], '^ws-', '')) AS user_id, ResourceAttributes['reliant.workspace.org.id'] AS org_id, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, toIntervalSecond(60)) AS b,
           argMaxIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'], TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] != '') AS node, max(TimeUnix) AS seen,
           ifNotFinite(avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage'), 0) AS cpu,
           maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set') AS mem,
           maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts') AS restarts
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND MetricName IN ('container.cpu.usage', 'container.memory.working_set', 'k8s.container.restarts') AND startsWith(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], 'ws-') AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']))
    GROUP BY workspace_id, user_id, org_id, container, b)
  GROUP BY workspace_id, user_id, org_id, b)
GROUP BY workspace_id, user_id, org_id ORDER BY cpu_peak_cores DESC LIMIT 25
